Implement it by changing the number of gradient accumulation micro-steps (1, 2, 4 at DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 32 or 64 as fits) per step. Leave the LR schedule unchanged.

backlog.spec: Add learnable per-layer scalar x0 skip: x = lambda_resid[i]*x + lambda_x0[i]*x0 (x0 is the post-embedding-norm input) if not already present, initialized lambda_resid=1 and lambda_x0=0.1, and put these scalars in the SCALAR_LR Adam group. If already present, instead add a learned U-Net-style skip that adds the output of layer i to layer DEPTH-1-i for the second half of layers, weighted by a zero-initialized scalar.
backlog.title: Value embeddings on alternating layers removal/add check: untied residual scalars

backlog.spec: Train the first 40% of the time budget with sequences truncated to 512 tokens (reshape each 2048 batch into 4x as many rows of 512 so the token count per step is unchanged), then switch to full 2048. Use a fixed window size consistent with the length, and expect one extra compile for the new shape. This gives cheaper early steps and more updates.
backlog.title: Sequence length curriculum

backlog.spec: Keep an exponential moving average of model parameters (decay 0.999, updated each step with torch._foreach_lerp_), and swap the EMA weights in before the final evaluation call, then restore them. Do not alter the evaluation call itself. Start the EMA at 50% of the budget, when the warmdown begins, to avoid contamination from early weights.

backlog.spec: After the Muon orthogonalization step, divide the update by a running second-moment estimate per output row (beta2=0.95), as in NorMuon, then rescale so the overall update RMS matches the original. Keep the LR and weight decay unchanged. This tests variance-adaptive Muon.

backlog.spec: Make the Muon cautious weight decay decay linearly with training progress from 0.2 to 0.0 by the end of training. Pass the progress-dependent value into the Muon step each iteration. This gives regularization early and an unbiased fit late.

backlog.spec: Make every 4th layer (layers where i%4==3) skip rotary embeddings (NoPE) while the others keep RoPE. Also multiply the normalized q and k by a learnable per-head scale initialized to 1.2. This is a small attention change aimed at long-range layers.
backlog.title: Untie and shrink: smaller vocab-side cost via QK-norm scale and no-RoPE layers

backlog.spec: Add an auxiliary loss predicting the token at t+2 using a second small head: a linear layer from the final normed hidden state to the vocab, with a separate weight initialized to zero. Total loss = main + 0.2*aux, and the aux weight decays linearly to 0 by the end of training. Evaluation uses only the main head and is unchanged.
backlog.title: Multi-token prediction auxiliary loss

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 96 (model_dim 576, rounded to a multiple of HEAD_DIM=128 as the code requires, i.e. 640 if it rounds up). Throughput is higher with fewer layers, so the model sees more tokens in 300 s. Keep the learning rates and rescale only if the code does not already use dim-scaled LR for Adam groups.
backlog.title: Wider shallower model: depth 6 with aspect 85

backlog.spec: Keep an exponential moving average copy of the model parameters (decay 0.999, updated every optimizer step under torch.no_grad using torch._foreach_lerp_ on a list of fp32 shadow params). Before the final evaluation call, swap the EMA weights into the model (copy_ the shadow into params). Do not touch the evaluation call itself, only do the swap just before it. Start EMA after the first 10% of training time to avoid early-weights bias.
backlog.title: EMA of weights for evaluation

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**16 (one micro-step of 32x2048 per step via DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=32, or 64 with grad accum 1 at 64x1024 tokens is not allowed, so use DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=32). Scale MATRIX_LR by 0.85 (to ~0.034) and EMBEDDING_LR by 0.85, keep WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5. Muon momentum stays the same. This tests whether more optimizer steps beat noisier gradients in 300s.

backlog.spec: Make Muon's cautious weight decay follow the schedule WEIGHT_DECAY * (1 - progress), where progress is the time-based training fraction already used for the LR schedule, instead of being constant 0.2. Set it in the same per-step place where the Muon momentum/LR are updated for each param group.
backlog.title: Weight decay linearly decayed to zero

backlog.spec: Change the logit softcap constant (currently probably 30) applied as softcap*tanh(logits/softcap) in the model forward to 15. Nothing else changes.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: For the first 25% of the time budget, train on sequences truncated to the first 512 tokens of each 2048-token row (reshape batches to (4B,512) so token count per step is unchanged), then switch to full 2048. Mark the shape dynamic or accept one recompile at the switch. Evaluation is untouched.
backlog.title: Sequence-length curriculum

backlog.spec: Add a small auxiliary loss: reuse the lm_head on the final hidden states to also predict the token at t+2 (targets shifted by one more), weighted 0.3 and linearly decayed to 0 by the end of training. The extra loss is only used in training; the evaluation path and main loss are unchanged. Implement it by computing the second cross-entropy on x[:, :-1] against targets[:, 1:].
backlog.title: Multi-token prediction auxiliary loss

backlog.spec: Add an auxiliary loss term 1e-4 * mean(logsumexp(logits)^2) to the training loss only, computed from the fp32 logits already available in the forward when targets are given and training. Do not alter the evaluation reduction path.
backlog.title: Zero-centered Z-loss on logits

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH=10 and ASPECT_RATIO=51 so model_dim is about 512 (a multiple of HEAD_DIM 128; 4 heads), giving a deeper, narrower model with similar parameters. Keep other hyperparameters. If VRAM overflows, set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=32.
backlog.title: Depth 10 with narrower aspect ratio

backlog.spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine decay over the final 50% of the time budget, going to FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.03 rather than 0. Keep Muon momentum schedule untouched. A single change to the LR multiplier function.
backlog.title: Cosine-shaped warmdown with floor

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS=(0.8, 0.99) and SCALAR_LR=0.25 together, to stabilize the per-layer scalar and embedding updates that use Adam with small batches.
backlog.title: Adam beta2 0.99 and lower scalar LR

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**16 (one micro-step of 32x2048 per optimizer step, or adjust DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE so grad accumulation is 1). Scale MATRIX_LR by about 0.85 (to 0.034) and EMBEDDING_LR by 0.85. Keep WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5. The smaller batch gives about twice as many steps in the 300 s budget.
backlog.title: Batch 2**16 with scaled LRs

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 and keep every other setting. This tests the other side of the batch optimum, because the 2**19 to 2**17 move helped a lot. If DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 gives 2 micro-steps, that is 4 accumulation steps for 2**18 tokens. Only change TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE.
backlog.title: Batch 2**18 with higher LR check

backlog.spec: Keep an fp32 EMA copy of the model parameters with decay 0.999, updated every step with torch._foreach_lerp_ (or the equivalent). Before the final evaluation, swap the EMA weights into the model. Do not touch the evaluation call itself; only copy the EMA params into model.parameters() right after the training loop ends. Start the EMA at step 0 and use decay=min(0.999, (1+t)/(10+t)).

backlog.spec: Change the logit softcap from its current value (likely 30) to 15 in the forward pass, i.e. logits = 15*tanh(logits/15). This is a one-constant change. It stabilizes the output distribution at a small learning-rate cost.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Lower WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1. Keep the existing linear decay with progress. The model is small and trains for only about 300 s, so the regularization may be hurting.
backlog.title: Weight decay linearly to zero plus WD 0.1

backlog.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.03 so the LR ramps linearly from 0 over the first 3% of the time budget. This may allow stable use of higher peak LRs. Change nothing else.
backlog.title: Short warmup 3%

backlog.spec: Make the warmdown shape cosine instead of linear: lr_mult = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*t)) with t the fraction through the warmdown phase. Set FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.05. Keep WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5.
backlog.title: Final LR frac 0.05 with cosine warmdown

backlog.spec: Add an auxiliary loss 1e-4 * mean(logsumexp(logits)**2) to the training loss only, computed from float32 logits before the softcap-independent cross-entropy. The evaluation path must stay unchanged, so apply it only when targets are passed in training mode. If the loss function is shared with evaluation, compute the extra term in the training loop instead. This keeps the logits normalized.
backlog.title: Z-loss on logits

backlog.spec: Set MATRIX_LR to 0.05 and EMBEDDING_LR to 0.4. Both are pure hyperparameter changes. The new batch size is smaller, and the best LR split may have moved.
backlog.title: Matrix LR 0.05 with embedding LR 0.4

backlog.spec: Add a second prediction target. Compute logits2 from the final hidden states with the same lm_head, applied to a cheap per-token shift: h2 = h + a small linear (n_embd to n_embd, zero-init) projection of h. Its target is the token 2 positions ahead, using the targets shifted by one with the last position ignored (-1). Add 0.3 * CE2 to the training loss only. Evaluation uses only the main head, so the eval path stays untouched. This gives denser gradient signal per step.

Helped: only the batch change. Cutting TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**17 gave -0.0634 (runs 1.0516/1.0529); incumbent mean is 1.0514. The slot 0 tripwire flag still needs checking.

Did not help: architecture (a=1, b=7), optimizer (a=1, b=5) and schedule tweaks. Worse: Adam beta1 0.9 (+0.0063), SwiGLU (+0.0032), DEPTH 6 (+0.0125), HEAD_DIM 64 (+0.0034), sync every 10 steps (+0.0044), and the batch ramp (+0.0219, 1.0692). Small gains of 0.003 or less may be noise: Muon momentum ramp 1.0506 (-0.0035), WINDOW_PATTERN "SL" (-0.0031), UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.008 (-0.0009 over 2 runs), WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.7 (-0.0006).

Next: try a fixed 2**16 batch, retuning LR and warmdown for it. Try combining the momentum ramp, UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.008 and WINDOW_PATTERN "SL", and replicate any combined gain. Avoid more MLP, activation or depth swaps.
